title: Agonyte Time
description: This mod allows the player to create their own infection in the world. (forge 1.20.1)
body: This mod allows the player to create their own infection, which they can spread around the world (or decide to become a kind of "Paladin" on the server and destroy infected biomes). I will not make any fashion guide, because it is enough to go into the mod and read the description of the items to understand what each item does.
